# Third-party assets — hugmesh-character-forge-bff-api

Repo-wide aggregation of every third-party asset vendored into this repository.
**Generated by `tools/asset-pipeline/build-manifests.mjs` — do not hand-edit;
change `tools/asset-pipeline/sources.json` and re-run `./build.sh`.**

Machine-readable per-model provenance (`licenseSpdx` / `attribution` /
`sourceUrl` / `retrievedAt`, plus the measured triangle/bone/viseme audit) lives
in `godot/character-forge/assets/packs/<packId>/pack.json`.

Vendored *code* (the godot-vrm and MToon addons) is tracked separately in
`godot/character-forge/THIRD_PARTY_ASSETS.md` +
`godot/character-forge/addons/THIRD_PARTY_MANIFEST.json`.

## License discipline (binding)

Only CC0 / CC-BY items carrying a positive redistribution verdict in the XR-chat
research reports (`legal-inventory.md`, `kemono.md`, `jrpg-bases.md`,
`link-audit.md`) may be vendored. **Nothing** from Mixamo, Synty, VRoid Hub,
BOOTH, CGTrader, or unverified Sketchfab uploads. VRoid meshes ship only as
fixed whole avatars and never enter the part-mixer (pixiv VRoid Studio guideline).
Every file gets a `pack.json` entry with its licence quoted from the source.

## Where the licence is enforced at runtime

The manifests below are not the only place this discipline lives — the code
refuses to load an asset that lacks them:

| Layer | File | What it enforces |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Basis registry | `godot/character-forge/scripts/part_registry.gd` | A mesh basis is REJECTED (family stays procedural) unless it carries `licenseSpdx` on the CC0/CC-BY/MIT allow-list plus `attribution`, `sourceUrl` and an ISO `retrievedAt`. |
| Pack library | `godot/character-forge/scripts/pack_library.gd` | Copies those four fields verbatim out of `pack.json` into the registry entry; a catalogue that fails to load leaves every family procedural. |
| Lane build | `tools/asset-pipeline/build-lanes.mjs` | Fails the build when a lane names a pack, model, family or palette region that does not exist. |
| Engine tests | `godot/character-forge/tests/run_tests.gd` | Asserts every catalogue entry passes the licence gate, that each `glb` path exists on disk, and that an NC licence is still refused. |
| In-app credit | `frontend/src/app/character-forge/panels/pack-selector.component.html` | Shows the licence and credit on every model card — what discharges the CC-BY visibility requirement. |

User-imported models never enter any of this: the importer reads the file in
the browser, hands the bytes to the engine, and surfaces the file's OWN
in-file licence terms. Nothing imported is uploaded, stored or redistributed.

### VRoid Studio CC0 sample models (base bodies)
- **License:** CC0-1.0 · **Author:** VRoidプロジェクト (VRoid Project / pixiv Inc.)
- **Source:** https://opengameart.org/content/vroid-studio-cc0-models · **Retrieved:** 2026-07-29
- **Path:** `godot/character-forge/assets/packs/vroid-cc0-v1/`
- **Licence text as read at the source:**
  > OpenGameArt licence block on the submission page: CC0. Corroborated by the VRM's own in-file metadata: extensions.VRM.meta.licenseName == "CC0" (read back by audit.mjs after slimming), with otherLicenseUrl granting redistribution=allow, modification=allow, corporate_commercial_use=allow, credit=unnecessary.
- **Notes:** PART-MIXER PROHIBITION: VRoid meshes are shipped ONLY as fixed, whole avatars. They must never enter the part-mixer — pixiv's VRoid Studio guideline bars apps that generate/output models from deformed or recombined VRoid meshes (jrpg-bases.md killer clause). AvatarSample_D/E/F/G from the same OGA bundle are deliberately NOT shipped: their in-file licenseName is "Other" (not "CC0"), and at 26.7k-34.4k tris / 417-498 joints they blow the Quest budget with no safe decimation path.

## Evaluated and deliberately NOT vendored

- **oga-modular-rpg-characters-g6** (CC0-1.0) — https://opengameart.org/content/modular-rpg-characters
  BLENDER REQUIRED. Verified by listing both archives the page offers: modular_rpg_characters.7z = 53 files / 2 folders, of which the only geometry is human_female.blend + human_male.blend (the other 51 are textures/*.png + READ_ME.txt); modular_rpg_characters_ik_rig_for_animating.7z = animations_bake_human_female.blend + animations_bake_human_male.blend + READ_ME.txt. No FBX/glTF/DAE export exists anywhere in either download. Blender is not installed in this environment, so there is no honest conversion path; skipped rather than faked.
- **oga-base-rigged-stylized-humanoid-yw** (CC0-1.0) — https://opengameart.org/content/base-rigged-stylized-humanoid-character-yw
  BLENDER REQUIRED. Verified by archive listing: basemesh_a1_human_yw_by_girush_2.7z = 8 files, geometry is baseMesh_A1_(human_YW)_by_Girush.blend (+ its .blend1 autosave) and the rest are PNG maps + readme.txt. No exported mesh format.
- **kaykit-character-animations** (CC0-1.0) — https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-animations
  WRONG RIG — measured, not assumed. The pack downloads fine (lib/itch-fetch.sh, free upload, LICENSE.txt inside reads 'License: (Creative Commons Zero, CC0)'), but Animations/gltf/KayKit_AnimatedCharacter_v1.2.glb is the blocky 'PrototypePete' demo character on a 6-JOINT rig, while the KayKit Adventurers/Skeletons characters we ship are a 41-bone rig. Its 30 clips therefore cannot drive the shipped characters without a rig-aware retarget (Blender / a BoneMap authored in the Godot editor). The 76-clip library already extracted from the Adventurers pack is on the CORRECT rig and covers the social poses this room needs (Idle, Cheer, Sit_Chair_*, Sit_Floor_*, Lie_*, Interact, PickUp, Throw, Walking/Running variants). Only Wave/Dance/Climbing/Hop/Roll are unique to the standalone pack — recorded as a follow-up for a Blender-equipped machine rather than shipped as clips nothing can play.
- **quaternius-rpg-character-pack** (CC0-1.0) — https://quaternius.com/packs/rpgcharacters.html
  No scriptable download. Unlike every other Quaternius pack this one has no itch.io listing; the site's only download button opens a Google Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MIRQXLfTd21HMI5rwOb6Xy0rv0xv1m8b), which cannot be fetched deterministically without an account/API key. Its coverage overlaps Universal Base Characters + Modular Outfits + KayKit Adventurers, so nothing is lost functionally.
- **sketchfab-anthro-candidates** (CC-BY-4.0 (uploader-asserted)) — https://sketchfab.com/AtheoFreak/collections/free-furry-avatars-f9f06a955a834dad8dfb8a17b0022191
  Sketchfab's Download API requires an OAuth/account token (the 'archives' field is null unauthenticated), and link-audit.md rates the collection provenance-poisoned — every candidate needs per-model IP vetting. Out of scope for an unauthenticated pipeline.
